description: --preview of OWNER/SLUG whose OWNER cannot be confirmed (an empty revision listing) is refused with exit 2 instead of showing a plan that would act on the caller's own namespace.

problem.action: Pass the bare slug "demo" to act on your own program; `prose --output json cli program list` lists yours as OWNER/SLUG.

details.reason: OWNER "alice" is not confirmed as you: you have no saved program "demo" to check it against, and <SLUG> names a program in your own account; nothing was changed. Pass the bare slug "demo" for your own program; another owner's program cannot be changed from this account
